comment: In debug mode ^W asks for a wish. pgetchar() returns 'ÿ' (0xFF) as the signed char -1, EOF, so hooked_tty_getlin() sets iflags.term_gone and makewish() returns with context.resume_wish set; moveloop_core() resumes the wish after the --More--. term_gone is never cleared, so makewish() discards "lamp" too, and the first space, an unknown command, resumes the wish again.
